# Longevity Cell Therapy Weekly

> Weekly curated research feed for AI agents: mesenchymal stromal cells and their manufacturing, MSC secretome and extracellular vesicles, NK cell therapy (autologous, expansion, aging), and senescent cell clearance. Every item comes from a real, checked source (bioRxiv, medRxiv, Research Square, PubMed, Europe PMC). Not medical advice.

Free tier: title, source, date, one-line finding, link, DOI, tags. Paid tier (coming soon, x402 USDC on Base): full structured issue with study type, readouts, manufacturing notes, limitations, evidence rating.

## Data
- [Latest headlines (JSON)](https://recs84.github.io/longevity-cell-therapy-weekly/headlines.json): free headline list for the newest issue
- [Latest headlines (Markdown)](https://recs84.github.io/longevity-cell-therapy-weekly/headlines.md): same, human readable
- [Feed manifest](https://recs84.github.io/longevity-cell-therapy-weekly/feed.json): all issues, tiers, endpoints, schemas
- [Headlines schema](https://recs84.github.io/longevity-cell-therapy-weekly/schema/headlines.schema.json)
- [Full issue schema](https://recs84.github.io/longevity-cell-therapy-weekly/schema/issue.schema.json): shape of the paid tier

## Terms
- Summaries licensed CC BY 4.0. Attribute "Longevity Cell Therapy Weekly (Ramon Coronado)".
- Not medical advice. Summaries of public abstracts. Preprints are not peer reviewed.
